message.content: Columbia University is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University in 1896. It is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the United States and is known for its rigorous academic programs across a wide range of disciplines, including humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, business, law, medicine, and journalism. The main campus is situated on Morningside Heights in Manhattan, while additional campuses include the Columbia Business School in Midtown Manhattan, the Columbia Law School in Upper Manhattan, and the Columbia School of Social Work in Washington Heights.
